request_json.message: Can I trust your answers for safety decisions?

response_json.response:
🤖 Use me as a quick lookup, not the final word.
• Stock figures come from the warehouse database and are only as current as its last update.
• Procedures come from the SOP library — I name the SOP and section so you can check it.
• I can be wrong, and I don't cover anything outside those sources (law, medicine, finance, decisions about people).
• For safety decisions, confirm with the SOP and your shift supervisor.
